At startup the «🏠 Home» screen appears. The radio tabs (including Baofeng K67 Pro and Bajeton 8300) open from the model gallery and close with ×.

The «📻 Models» tab lists the radios of all brands (Baofeng, Bajeton, Quansheng, Retevis, Radtel, Radioddity, TIDRADIO and others; choose the brand from the «All brands» menu), divided into «COMPATIBLE MODELS» and «NON-COMPATIBLE MODELS» (with the number of models) and, in each part, by type (Amateur radio, DMR, GMRS / FRS, PMR446 and licence-free, For children); within each type the models are grouped by brand (Baofeng and Bajeton first, then the others), in alphabetical order. Every model has its own card, even when it is handled like another one (e.g. UV-5RA like UV-5R; the equivalent models listed in CHIRP's table say so on the card). Search for the model and filter by brand, type and features. Click on the radio to open its channel tab, update its firmware or download the manufacturer's programs and manuals.

«🗑 Delete» removes the checked repeaters from the archive (or, if you have not checked any, the selected ones; the Del key deletes the selected rows); «🗑 Delete all» empties the archive, also of the repeaters hidden by the filters. Both ask for confirmation and can be undone with ↶ (Ctrl+Z).

«📻 Forward to the radio» writes the checked repeaters (or, if you have not checked any, the selected ones) to the target radio shown above the table: if a radio is already chosen it asks you to confirm, otherwise you can choose it from the list of all compatible radios, divided by brand and type, with each model listed individually in alphabetical order.

Before writing, the program checks that the repeaters are compatible with the chosen radio: frequencies within the radio's ranges, no amateur repeater on a PMR446 / licence-free or GMRS device, no digital-only repeater (DMR, C4FM, D-Star, NXDN) on an analogue-only radio (on DMR radios DMR-only repeaters become DMR channels). If something is wrong a warning appears: you can cancel, choose another radio or, if part of the repeaters is compatible, send only that part. Radios sold as PMR446 / licence-free or GMRS that also accept amateur frequencies (driver ranges taken from the manufacturer's program) get a yellow warning instead of a block: you can still write the repeaters, both with «Forward to the radio» and from the radio's tab. Respect the rules: in Italy transmitting on amateur frequencies requires a licence and a type-approved PMR446 device must not be modified.

Digital channels (DMR on the DM-32UV, encrypted digital on the D-series PMR radios): «Mode» column; subtones apply only to analogue channels and digital channels are not copied to analogue-only radios.
